VTEC valve control
signals.description: VTEC works by switching between two (or sometimes three) different camshaft profiles by engaging or disengaging a mechanism that locks the valve rocker arms together. When VTEC is OFF, the engine operates using the standard cam profile, which is typically optimized for fuel efficiency and low-end torque. When VTEC is ON, the system switches to a high-performance cam profile that allows the valves to open wider and for a longer duration, enabling better airflow at higher RPMs for increased power.
